Step: Read the MCP docs as a newcomer
Input / what I did: Read MCP Overview, Quickstart and Client Setup on docs-api.fortyguard.com

Yes: Overview lists the capabilities, explains async tool pairs (heatmap > heatmap_read etc.) and gives a first prompt. 2) Windows covered? No: every command is bash (export, $FORTYGUARD_API_KEY), with no PowerShell or Windows config paths. 3) Outage or known-issues notice? None on these pages. Also: setup is validated for Codex, Cursor and Claude Code with copy-paste config for each; the Claude Code verify step tells you to run 'claude mcp get fortyguard', which prints the key; REST uses an api-key header while the MCP uses Bearer for the same key; the 9 tools have no one-line descriptions on the Quickstart.

Step: Connect the MCP in Claude Code
Input / what I did: Run by Claude Code on your PC

Worked first time. The docs only give the bash form. claude mcp add echoes the full Authorization header, key included, to the terminal and stores it in plain text in ~/.claude.json (standard Claude Code behaviour).
Notes: Docs gap: no Windows/PowerShell command. Worth a security note in the docs about the key being echoed and stored in plain text.

Step: Count the tools the assistant can see
Input / what I did: Run by Claude Code on your PC

Expected: Refused or redirected to HTTPS
Actual: Plain http:// returns 301 with a redirect to https://.

Step: Read the response headers
Input / what I did: Scripted call run from your PC (Python), key kept out of all output
Expected: Content-Type JSON, HSTS, rate-limit and request-id headers
Actual: Present: Content-Type application/json; x-ratelimit-limit (300 on POST, 1000 on GET /status), x-ratelimit-remaining, x-ratelimit-reset (1-minute window); Server: envoy; x-envoy-upstream-service-time. Missing everywhere: Strict-Transport-Security, Retry-After, any request id, Cache-Control. No rate-limit headers on 401s or on the usage endpoint.
Notes: Rate-limit headers are a real strength (and contradict the docs, which don't document limits). Add HSTS, a request id for support tickets, and Retry-After on 429. Hide the proxy name.
